• Introduction & Conceptual Foundation (2 Marks): Comprehensive overview, definitions, contextual scope, and historical/theoretical relevance.
• Detailed Structural Analysis & Derivations (5 Marks): Deep exploration covering all relevant dimensions, mathematical proofs, architectural diagrams, or comparative taxonomies.
• Practical Applications & Critical Evaluation (2 Marks): Real-world applications, computational complexity, empirical validation, or critical critique.
• Conclusion & Summary (1 Mark): Concise synthesis connecting theoretical outcomes with course objectives.
Valuation Guidance: Full marks are awarded for clear structural organization, labeled diagrams/formulations where applicable, and exhaustive coverage of all sub-parts.

questions.question: Votre responsable doit partir en déplacement. Vous vous occupez de son billet de train. Demandez ses souhaits et notez-les pour faire la réservation. Rédigez ce dialogue. / [CO3] [10x2 = 20]
questions.solution_html:
• Votre responsable doit partir en déplacement. Vous vous occupez de son
  • billet de train. Demandez ses souhaits et notez-les pour faire la réservation.
  • Rédigez ce dialogue.
  • Reponse libre : Include questions to collect travel details such as:
  • • destination
  • • date and time of departure
  • • return date/time
  • • class (first/second class)
  • Show that you are taking notes and confirming the information.
  • Include polite and professional expressions (e.g., À quelle heure souhaitez-
  • vous partir ?, Je note, Très bien, Je m’en occupe). End with you confirming
  • that you will book the ticket [C] / [CO3: 10 marks]
  • [10 × 2 = 20]
